name: PageNarrowBody - Leads Body And Links
description: The narrow closing block a chapter page and a community page share: back link, leads, markdown body, then the entry's own links. It was written twice when communities got their own page type, differing only in the leads heading and the back-link wording — the shape where a spacing or accessibility fix lands on one copy and silently misses the other. Capturing it once is what makes the two pages provably share it.
